page_title: ChatPDF AI | Chat with any PDF | Free

summary.name: ChatPDF
summary.one_liner: ChatPDF is a web-based AI tool for chatting with, summarizing, and asking questions about PDFs and other documents.
use_cases: Summarize research papers and academic articles
Study for exams and get homework help from textbooks
Review legal contracts and financial reports
Compare multiple PDFs in one conversation
summary.what_it_does: ChatPDF lets users upload PDFs and chat with them in a conversational interface, asking questions and getting summaries or comparisons. Answers include citations linked to the source content, and a side-by-side view shows the chat alongside the PDF. Users can create folders to chat with multiple files at once. The page says it accepts documents in any language and can respond in any language. Supported formats listed in the FAQ include PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Markdown, and plain text.
notable: Built-in citations linked to the original PDF passages
caveats: Free plan limited to 2 documents per day; unlimited use requires the paid ChatPDF Plus plan
Multi-document chats and saved history require a free account
Page lists the AI models as GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini via dynamic routing
